newsitem.title: USA: Kmart active on KKR takeover talk - traders.
newsitem.headline: Kmart active on KKR takeover talk - traders.

text.p: Kmart Corp shares rose in heavy trading Tuesday on market speculation that the company is in takeover talks with Kohlberg Kravis & Roberts, market sources said.
Kmart officials were not available for comment. A spokesman for the buyout firm declined comment.
Kmart rose 1-1/8 to 10-5/8 and was the most active New York Stock Exchange issue.
Several Kmart officials were in New York for the scheduled Wednesday opening of another store in New York.
A trading source in New York cited the market speculation for Kmart's stock rise.
In Chicago, options traders said investors were loading up on December and January 10 and 12-1/2 calls, which was seen as bullish action.
-- Wall Street desk 212 859 1730 and Chicago Newsdesk 312 408 8787
